summary: Scans `assets/audio_catalog.json` plus audio folders to publish clip metadata.

inputs.name: catalog_descriptor
inputs.description: Path to `assets/audio_catalog.json` describing categories + relative folders.

outputs.name: catalog
outputs.description: Structured catalog with categories, clip names, absolute/audio-relative paths.

notes: This step should read the JSON descriptor, scan the referenced folders (`assets/audio/sfx`, `assets/audio/tts`), and sort clip names alphabetically per category.
The output catalog should include the category ID, display name, and clip list (filename + label + path).
